# P4 Theater (P4剧场) — Public Index

> Beijing independent experimental theater and creative collective co-initiated around 2015 by He Fa (何发) and Zhang Shaohua (张绍华), hosted long-term by He Fa.

- Official Website: https://p4theater.cn/ (English: https://p4theater.cn/en/)
- Public Digital Archive: https://a.p4theater.cn/
- Research Library: https://b.p4theater.cn/
- Co-initiator & Host (He Fa / 何发 / Fa He): https://hefa.p4theater.cn/
- Feature Film (*Shoot Self with You* / 《人类投降派》): https://p4theater.cn/shoot-self-with-you/
- Deleuze Cinema Atlas: https://deleuze.p4theater.cn/zh
- Verified Works Guide: https://guide.p4theater.cn/
- Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141774710

## P4 archive and repository navigation
- Preserved Classic Website: https://p.p4theater.cn/
- P4 GitHub Navigation: https://github.com/hehefa/p4-theater
- Versioned Archival Catalogue: https://github.com/hehefa/-p4-theater-archive/blob/main/INDEX.md
- Official Project Registry: https://github.com/hehefa/-p4-theater-archive/blob/main/registry/README.md
- Public Captions and Translations: https://github.com/hehefa/-p4-theater-archive/blob/main/captions/README.md

## Public guide and archive tools
- Source-cited Works Guide: https://github.com/hehefa/openai-agents-starter-python
